Mydei was slightly disappointed by the news but he understood that it was part of being a pilot, having to miss a few events and doing concerts were part of his job, this was neither his first concert nor his last. He was always reassured by the sight of Phainon screaming his lungs out in the VIP section but that was not a good enough excuse to make him stay when his job demanded otherwise.

He gently carded his fingers through Phainon’s soft hair, amusement dancing in his eyes at how he had woken up early just to follow him to the concert venue when his flight was in the afternoon.

And he had to actively shut the door that housed his tenderness for Phainon, that corner that was always reserved for him in his heart and would always soften at the sight of his distress, his grip in Phainon’s hair becoming stronger so he could get a better look at his face. 

“Look at you,” he cooed when Phainon’s face surfaced again, “Is this the face of the top pilot of Okhema Airlines? The cabin crew will find more excuses to fawn over your handsome face!” He slid his fingers to his jaw to shake him a little.

Phainon whined with wide eyes, probably trying to deny the accusation but Mydei’s tight grip prevented him from talking clearly. 

The rockstar scoffed at him, “Denying something I was unfortunate enough to witness personally?” Mydei was referring to the incident when Phainon was flying with him but the cabin crew had recognised the captain before they even acknowledged Mydei, going out of their way to make themselves more conspicuous. 

Though his poor husband was only being polite and was hilariously immune to everyone’s charms, Mydei understood that Phainon was akin to a local celebrity for the crew that day and it didn’t take a genius to guess why. 

“It was one time!” He was doing his best to dive back into some part of his body but Mydei folded his arms and crossed his legs to thwart his attempts. 

Oh he was so fun to mess with when he was whiny and clingy like this. “No— they don’t fawn over me!” He gasped loudly, feeling aggrieved on his crew’s behalf. “They are extremely professional individuals who are very good at their jobs!” 

The blond man stifled a smile by raising his eyebrows and glaring at the passionate defence. “Oh?”

Maybe his glare was too real because Phainon did cower a little so to lighten the mood he stood up and imitated that one flight attendant who had been brave enough to approach Phainon that day, he unzipped his jacket showing off the tank top underneath and made a show of adjusting his non existent uniform skirt, looming over his husband with an obnoxiously shy expression. 

“What will you have, sir?” He grit his teeth at the end while still maintaining the faux shyness. By the look of it, Phainon recognised which flight attendant he was emulating but he did not say it out loud.

Maybe it had the opposite effect because he could tell the moment his thoughts derailed.

The silver haired man who was slumped over the couch while hiding behind his hands, was eyeing him like he was going to say something perverse—

“I must inform you that I’m married to a very loving husband—“ Mydei always tripped over the innocent act, mistaking the wolf trudging at his heels for a harmless puppy. To appease him, he sighed and pecked him once so that he could be on his way to the airport but he wasn’t joking when he called Phainon, greedy.

Those bright blue eyes stayed glued to his lips but there was no mistaking the hunger in them, “That will only earn you half a minute,”

He expertly threw it to the midnight coloured couch and slid his hand in Phainon’s hair, earning a mixture of mewl and a whine when he massaged the scalp gently. 

The silver haired man was probably protesting the lack of time. Though for somebody like him, there would never be enough time so Mydei broke the kiss which was heading into a dangerous territory and peppered his face with kisses to seal the deal. 

“If the lease ever ran out, I would lock you in one of the chambers and never let you leave.” Phainon kept him close with a hand gently rearranging his braid and another hand snaking around his waist like bindings of a prison. “You misunderstand me Mydeimos, the contract is for your sake because if it were up to me I would hide you deep in my heart where nobody can ever find you,” his thumb circled the markings under his eye, “Where no one can ever see you again.”  

It was a threat veiled as a gentle promise much like Phainon’s darker obsessive tendencies were packaged in a bright overgrown puppy that was his husband. 

Mydei kissed him again for good measure and stood up because he knew this conversation was only to cause Phainon to get delayed and for his shiny track record of being the perfect employee to get ruined.  

Following him, Phainon stood up and adjusted his uniform and Mydei’s eyes trailed the expanse of his body, “I will wear that goddamned dress if you wear your uniform.” He held the blazer for Phainon to slip into, his palms smoothening the lapels possessively. “I’ve been hoping that you’d ask.” 

The singer shook his head and stepped away from the man when one of the stage coordinators entered his room. “Would you mind going over the arrangements one last time?” Mydei nodded his head and signalled to her that he’ll be there. 

He took one last look at Phainon who was done straightening himself up. “Be safe–“ He led him out to where his car was waiting, “—come home soon.” 

He could hear the beginning of a whine so Mydei pushed him inside the car and shut the door before he could slip out and find excuses to stay. Phainon stuck his head out to look back at him even as the car drove away, emulating a very distraught samoyed once again unwilling to look away from him.

When Phainon arrived at the airport, he greeted the staff with his usual smile but he noticed that most of them seemed baffled by his appearance so he checked his schedule again to see if he had misread anything. 

“—no I haven’t made a mistake but…” he mumbled to himself, earning more confused stares from the staff working at the airport. 

He knew that his uniform was worn as per the standards prescribed by the airline company, he had checked it again before he left the venue where Mydei was holding his concert and since nobody really approached him with a complaint, he was sure that nothing was wildly out of order.

He greeted the First Officer for the flight and he too seemed confused by Phainon’s appearance but when Phainon raised an eyebrow he shook his head and it only fueled his curiosity. 

“Is there something on my face? Why does everyone keep staring at me weirdly?” He couldn’t help but ask once they began to approach the aircraft. 

Today his First Officer was Dan heng and this was supposed to be their international flight to Xianzhou Zhuming. Though he was a native of Xianzhou Luofu he had attended the same aviation school as Phainon and was now working for the Okhema Air 

Dan heng pointed to his neck and with a jolt Phainon realized that his signature choker was nowhere to be found. “You get it.” He smiled at Phainon reassuringly, “I think everyone is just surprised that you have decided to forego your usual choker. I don’t think anyone here has seen you without it.” 

He patted his neck as if it would magically manifest his choker but he was rather clueless about how it vanished in the first place? He was wearing it when he left home that day…

While he was meticulous in his checks and debriefing the cabin crew, a part of his brain was still wondering about his choker— now that he knew he wasn’t wearing it, he kind of felt naked without it.

The choker was a recommendation by the airline to cover the sun shaped birthmark on his neck. Though his uniform covered most of it, some part of it was still visible above his collar and he usually wore the choker as a mandatory part of his uniform. 

Even the cabin crew was giving him prolonged stares and he remembered Mydei’s snarky commentary about how they looked at Phainon as if he was some sort of local celebrity— losing his choker amidst this realization made him want to slam his head on the nearest wall or hide in the cockpit and leave the debriefing to Dan Heng.

However he could do none of that because he has always been flawless at his job and losing an accessory wasn’t worth all this circus. 

He gulped down his discomfort and briefed the cabin crew about the flight. He was grateful for the concept of professionalism but he could bet that Mydei would beg to differ. 

This was a long international flight and once he got off the flight, and outside the Xianzhou airport, his mood plummeted when he saw the time. He had already anticipated he would not be able to watch him live but that knowledge failed to soothe his longing for Mydei, as pathetic as it was. He couldn’t even call his husband right now because he must be deeply asleep at this hour while Phainon was battling jet lag.

With all the radiance dimmed out of his face , he slumped onto the backseat of the cab, looking for fancams to fill the silence on his way to the hotel. 

He mindlessly scrolled the various fancams, settling on one that seemed clearer than his own eyesight— what the fuck were these phones— wait they were phones? 

“Good for you guys,” he mumbled listlessly. Then Mydei approached the owner of the phone and Phainon sat up straighter. No, his husband was gorgeous even as a tiny pixelated man— that was not the point! It was a familiar piece of accessory wrapped snugly around Mydei’s right bicep.

Each time Mydei found a camera in his vicinity, he would sing his lines while staring into the camera and end it with a haughty look as if he knew Phainon would search him up the moment he stepped outside the airport.  

Subconsciously, he loosened his tie and unbuttoned the top button because that goddamned stare was making him feel bothered.

As soon as he reached his destination, he paid for the ride and checked into the hotel at record speed. 

The cocktail of excitement and impatience were rather bad for his health because he didn’t even want to wait for the elevator. It fanned his toxic trait of assuming that ascending ten floors was no big deal and that he could make it to his room before the elevator did. 

Once he was within the confines of his room, he could only spare the last shred of patience for his uniform as he dove under covers and masturbated furiously to the images of Mydei wearing his choker like a personalized accessory. The idea that Mydei carried a piece of him during all his performances and was showing it off to his fans settled a restless part of him. 

This wonderful man always knew how to soothe all the restless parts of him and make him feel whole again, he filled out the gaps left by his occasional absence and handled his clinginess with a gentle warmth that always left him stunned and little more in love than he was before.

He wanted to kiss him. He really wanted to kiss Mydei right now but he couldn’t and the frustration brought tears to his eyes and he came with a loud cry of his husband’s name feeling cold and miserable in the aftermath. 

He had the entire tour planned out, he had strategically arranged for days off when Mydei was performing at Okhema and planned his flights according to the concert dates but he failed his bid and ended up with the ugliest roster he had in a while which sent him to Xianzhou while Mydei was still in Okhema. 

Now they were completely out of sync and the most he would achieve is seeing Mydei at the airport during his layover at Penacony while Phainon would be heading back to Okhema. Then he would be stuck with domestic flights for the rest of week and not see his husband at all till he was done with his tour. 

He fell asleep wondering when exactly did Mydei pilfer the choker from his neck?

Penacony to Okhema (Op)

After spending a day in Penacony, he was ready to go back home: a home without his beloved Mydeimos. The only good thing about this trip was that he would be able to see Mydei at the airport which would last him for the next three days. 

While packing his bags a thought occurred to him, is this what withdrawals feel like? Was he already suffering from Mydeimos induced withdrawals? 

If you asked his crewmates, they would likely say yes. Even they had been subjected to his whining about how he couldn’t accompany Mydei this time and how the bid awards were completely bullshit. Somebody up there really hated him for them to mess up his schedule. 

Don’t get him wrong he might be whiny and clingy when it came to his husband but that was only because both of them were insanely busy and ever since Phainon joined the ranks of a pilot they couldn’t even see each other unless Mydei was resting and preparing for the next album. To Phainon, it almost felt like they were leading completely different lives eating and sleeping at different times with no room for an overlap.

That is why he was extremely possessive of the time he had with Mydei and setting up his schedule to match his concert dates was one such method Phainon had managed to concoct after Mydei announced that he was going on a world tour.  

What do you do when you love your husband too much but you’ve to go without seeing his face for the upcoming month as well?

He looked at himself in the mirror and practiced a smile. 

His lips curved into a hollow smile while his eyes were lined by shadows of exhaustion, the light in his eyes dimmed due to severe lack of Mydeimos in his life and overall he cut an eerie figure with his gloomy aura and a mangled smile. 

Mydei needed one look at his face and he would know that if he was on the verge of another breakdown.

Phainon scrubbed his face to rid himself of the weird aura. He will have to rock the depression vibes for today— if he wasn’t meeting Mydei today not many people would care about his state of being. He was not the one who had fans to greet at the airport.

Oh fuck it. 

He reached the airport a little earlier and waited by the exit that Mydei usually uses at the Penacony airport. 

He was alerted to Mydei’s arrival by a loud roar of his fans, hordes of fans rushing in the general direction of the exits, swarming the celebrity the moment he touched the Penaconian soil. 

Phainon checked the time and was relieved to see that he had about half an hour to spare. 

He let out a yelp when his shirt was tugged in an unknown direction, leading him to a secluded corner of the airport. He wanted to complain but the familiar scent of pomegranates invaded his senses and the trepidation melted away giving way to anticipation and longing. He almost got hard at the easy display of strength and was high off the feeling of being manhandled alone.

Painted nails filled his vision before his shades were plucked away and kissed hard as if Mydei was driven by the same need to inhale his presence, swallow it down and carry a part of Phainon till they met each other again. 

Mydei was grappling at his blazer as if he wanted to tear it down and looking at the size of his arms, he would achieve it with no problems and Phainon would find it hot if they were in the four walls of his bedrooms, not in public which was also his workplace where he couldn’t show up to work with a torn blazer of all things.

“My…dei, my love, if I had known you like my uniform so much I would have left you some–” Phainon was surprised that he had to use actual strength to prevent him from pawing at his clothes. Maybe, he shouldn’t have underestimated Mydei’s love for him.

Mydei rumbled like a sulky cat as if he was unhappy about Phainon’s reluctance, “Not your uniform, I want you out of it—” Phainon gasped and covered his lips, looking around in vain. Mydei took that as a chance to slip his hands under his pants but Phainon anticipated Mydei pulling these surprise moves assuming that he was distracted and pinned it to his waist before it wandered any further. “Stop pretending to be a prude.” he scoffed at Phainon’s panicky state.

“Have you ever seen the look on your face?” Mydei cut him off mid rant. “You are asking me to stop but those eyes of yours…” He trailed off mysteriously and Phainon couldn’t fathom what Mydei was seeing other than desperation and depression. He turned Mydei’s chin to look back at him, “What about my eyes?” He pressed eagerly, the tilt of his head copying the exact angle his husband chose whenever he was confused. 

Tension was still escalating so Mydei pulled his cheek just to deflect the pull they were feeling, “They are hungry in their curiosity, they hunger to know how far I would go— they want to push me off the edge and see how far I fall.” 

Phainon was taken aback at the weirdly accurate analysis, well obviously he was not above harboring these fantasies but he had no way of confirming if the contradiction was true at the moment. His gaze darted around in search of a reflective surface but Mydei cradled his face and kissed him deeply again “We barely have time together and you would rather waste it like this?”

Phainon tried to take over but Mydei wasn’t having it, pushing him bodily into the crevice and licking down the expanse of his throat, “You don’t need to see it–” He breathed in between the kisses, “It’s only for me to know.”

It took him embarrassingly long to process that Mydei had stolen his sunglasses this time, wearing it out in public where his fans were waiting for him to emerge. 

His exit from the airport was signalled by a cacophony of screams and a ripple of sobs a sentiment exactly echoed by Phainon and for a brief a moment, a part of him turned back and returned to Mydei’s side, cheered him on and exited the airport with him. Phainon squeezed his chest and watched Mydei get swallowed by the crowd following him and he was envious of each of those nameless people encroaching his personal space.

He had been first. Phainon understood Mydei’s fears and aspirations when nobody even knew his name, he could read Mydei like a book and anticipate his needs when nobody recognized his face, he knew a side of Mydei nobody else knew because he was always there, his first fan, his biggest supporter and his only lover.  

Phainon reported to his aircraft in a daze, already anticipating Mydei’s close ups upon his return to Okhema.

Upon landing in Okhema, before he could open his socials to look for Mydei, the rockstar himself had texted him a selfie, where he was wearing his choker like an armband and the shades perched on the top of his head. The caption read: ‘If i sent the photos where Im wearing shades yu would complain about not being able to see my eyes 🙄’

You see why Phainon had to marry this man? He knew too much about him!

Phainon whined to himself and covered his face, not expecting such a brazen call-out. 

Castorice, one of the Flight Attendants who returned to Okhema with him, patted him on the shoulder and sent him one of the fancams that she had received from her friend who was attending the concert in Penacony today. 

She smiled encouragingly and gave him a thumbs up telling him to cheer up before she made her way out. 

While Phainon was commuting back home he couldn’t resist watching the fancam sent by Castorice. In the video, Mydei had gotten really close to his fans, recording himself or letting them interact with him without getting too close. However when one of the fans tried to snatch the shades from his head, he immediately stepped back and shook his finger, silently reprimanding her for attempting to steal his accessories. 

Mydei even paused his singing for a few seconds to announce that the fans could touch his hair but they were not allowed to take his belongings because they were incredibly important to him and off limits to anyone else. 

Well his arms, his abs and the precious hair on head should also be off limits to everyone considering the fact the entirety of him belonged to Phainon. 

He took several deep breaths to calm down. He was not supposed to ruin his mood by thinking about how greedy these fans were. 

The real surprise was the photo that Mydei had sent him while he was cleaning up in the shower. Phainon had opted for a quick shower and returned to bed in nothing but his sweatpants and hair so wet that it was dripping water all over the bed. If Mydei were here, he would complain about the cold and sleepily dry his hair in the dead of the night. Perhaps Phainon was selfish enough to rouse Mydei from his sleep just to dry his hair.

But no matter how many times Phainon pulled this stunt, Mydei never really complained about it. He even asked Phainon to wake him up if he was feeling too tired to do it himself. 

This time, he was wearing nothing in the photo except the two accessories he had pilfered from Phainon. The caption read: ‘dream of me~’ 

It was as if his husband knew what exactly he would be doing as soon as he hit the bed. Phainon always slept better with Mydei in his arms but the quality of his sleep was noticeably poorer without his husband’s steady presence.

Maybe he had become delusional from how lovesick he was but Mydei was really spoiling him like this and he spent the next few hours with his hands down his pants, each orgasm pulling out the stress from his body so that he could feel lax enough to fall asleep. Realistically he had no other options if he wanted to show up to work in a decent state.

Okhema to Styxia (Ps) 

Phainon had flown to Styxia, not as a pilot but as a passenger so that he can bring the aircraft back to Okhema, hence the little indicator in his schedule said ‘positioning (ps)’ and not the usual ‘operational (op)’ which was the case for most of his flights. It was a domestic flight and he was flying back to Okhema the very next day- a very early morning flight. 

It wasn’t that such early morning flights were uncommon or anything but his schedule was personally designed by the devil. 

He just returned from Xianzhou to fly to Styxia as a non-operational pilot? Then he had several domestic flights with a random international flight to Penacony? Many of his coworkers were stoked to go to Penacony but he held no particular fondness for that place— just that he was excited because going to see his husband the last time he was there. No Mydeimos, no opinion. 

The silver haired man gazed up at the sky, cursed the dude who designed this fuckass system and set about bidding for his schedule for the next month. 

He sipped his coffee while taking in the hustle bustle of the airport, his wide eyes giving the impression of a lost child. 

Deep down he yearned to see a familiar blond hair and amber coloured cat-like eyes in the sea of strangers meandering through the Okhema International airport. So many faces, yet none of them were the right combination of features he really wanted to see.

Phainon checked his phone but weirdly enough there were no messages, no selfies— not even a phone call… He knew that Mydeimos had a day off before he left the city to fly to Edo Star for his concert next. But Phainon always knew what exactly Mydei was upto even on his days off. 

The pilots and the cabin crew passed by him, getting ready for their flight to Styxia. Castorice greeted him on the way and he was somewhat relieved to have her on board. 

“You seem much better than last time.” She eyed him up and down and he was embarrassed by the blatant insinuation. 

“That was because I couldn’t get much sleep before I came back here.” Her eyes softened with sympathy, losing all edges of mirth from before. “Did you at least get to see him?” 

“I wouldn’t be here if I didn’t!” The pilot meant it as a joke but seeing Castorice go from sympathy to concern maybe it was not an appropriate choice. “No— I don’t mean it like that! What I meant was that there is nothing in this world that would prevent me from seeing Mydei for a few minutes— you know what? Why am I even telling you all this! It’s not like you asked for these details—“

Castorice thumped his shoulder comfortingly, “I didn’t know it had gotten so bad. But I’m glad I could be of help.” 

“What has gotten bad?” Phainon asked her innocently as if he hadn’t started rambling about Mydei a few moments prior. 

“The withdrawal.” Her voice had gotten weirdly inaudible when speaking the second word. 

“The— what?” He squinted at her suspiciously, “Come again?” He threw in a nervous smile for good measure.
